note: Local names people use (towns, markets, post offices, landmarks) that are not in the official area or village lists. Each entry needs either an official source_url, or source 'local name, added by the team' with the team member who confirmed it. Never guess a union or town: if it is not confirmed, leave union_bn and municipality_bn null (the site then shows the whole upazila). Used only by the area search; no phone numbers here.
fields: id, name_bn, name_en, type, district, upazila_en, municipality_bn, union_bn, source, source_note, source_url, added_by, added_on
